newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates surge despite fund inflow.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates surge despite fund inflow.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates surged despite a net inflow of funds from the maturity of an auction of Federal Investment Bonds, dealers said.
The overnight funds opened at 12 percent and soon rose to touch the 16 percent mark as the market was short of funds despite the inflow, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
Heavy trading was reported for one-week funds between 15 and 16.5 percent, the dealer said.
